Research areas include Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN), Vision-Language Action (VLA), World Action Model (WAM), and AI Agent.



2026-Present: Master of Science, Nanyang Technological University, specializing in Machine Learning, under supervision of Prof. Lihua Xie.
2021-2025: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), Chongqing University of Technology, majoring in Computer Science and Technology, under supervision of Prof. Xiaofei Zhu.





Lenovo (Shanghai) Information Technology Co., Ltd. (LR Robotics Algorithm) — Embodied AI Research Intern (Robotics) 2026.05-2026.08


Leveraging the Lenovo Morningstar robot as the platform, a collaborative intelligent agent system has been constructed, comprising the task-planning “mastermind” NavAgent and the dual-system navigator InternVLA-N1-DualVLN. NavAgent utilizes the LangGraph state machine and MCP to orchestrate the ROS2 toolkit, handling global task parsing, memory storage, telemetry self-checks, and anomaly diagnosis. DualVLN manages specific motion generation: System 2 (2 Hz; fine-tuned QwenVL-2.5) predicts 2D pixel sub-goals, while System 1 (30 Hz; NextDiT) outputs high-frequency physical trajectories. SR increased by 10.1%, SPL increased by 6.7%, NE decreased by 17.6%, and StR decreased by 32.5%.





Fine-tuning and Closed-loop Evaluation of SmolVLA Robot Fruit-Grasping Strategies Based on Multimodal Synthetic Data 2026.07-Present


This project established an end-to-end development pipeline—spanning multi-objective synthetic data generation, VLA policy fine-tuning, and closed-loop evaluation—on AMD GPUs (ROCm). Leveraging the Genesis IK expert controller, the team autonomously generated and aggregated a standard LeRobot multimodal dataset comprising 150 episodes (over 30,000 frames) featuring three categories of geometric fruit. Building on this, SmolVLA underwent imitation learning fine-tuning, achieving a 76% success rate in end-to-end closed-loop placement tasks within environments characterized by cross-domain visual and physical disturbances (an 8% improvement over models without domain randomization).


OmniVLN: Open-Set Instance-Level 3D Semantic Mapping with Rotating LiDAR and Panoramic Vision Co-first Author, IEEE RA-L (SCI Q2 TOP, Under Review)


To address the lack of spatial reasoning capabilities in LLMs and the issue of context explosion within large-scale 3D environments, we developed an omnidirectional perception-driven embodied AI agent framework using Python, PyTorch, and ROS 2. The front-end integrates rotating LiDAR and panoramic vision to construct a five-layer dynamic scene graph, utilizing persistent homology-based adaptive room segmentation and VLM-based hybrid pruning. At the decision-making level, we pioneered the use of 3D 8-neighbor connectivity and multi-resolution spatial attention prompting to achieve zero-shot long-range navigation; this resulted in a 93.18% success rate (with a 22.73% improvement in viewpoint-dependent accuracy) and a 69.98% reduction in token costs.


A Review of Data Fusion and Deep Learning Models for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis. First Author, Published to In Proceedings of E-commerce and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI 2024)

联想（上海）信息技术有限公司（LR Robotics Algorithm）- 机器人具身智能研究实习生 2026.05-2026.08


以联想晨星机器人为载体，构建了由任务规划主脑NavAgent与双系统导航InternVLA-N1-DualVLN协同智能体系统。NavAgent基于LangGraph状态机与MCP统一调度ROS2工具箱，负责全局任务解析、记忆存储、遥测自检与异常诊断。DualVLN负责具体的运动生成，利用System2（2HZ，微调QwenVL-2.5）预测2D像素亚目标，并由System1（30HZ，NextDiT）输出高频物理轨迹。SR提升10.1%，SPL提升6.7%，NE降低17.6%，StR降低32.5%。

title: 中文简历
text:
项目经历

基于多模态合成数据的SmolVLA机器人水果抓取策略微调与闭环评测 2026.07-2026.08


本项目在AMD GPU（ROCm）构建了“多目标仿真合成数据生成 → VLA策略微调 → 闭环评测”的全链路开发。利用Genesis的IK专家控制器自主生成并聚合了包含150组（3万+帧） 3类几何水果的标准LeRobot多模态数据集。在此基础上完成了SmolVLA的模仿学习微调，并在包含跨域视觉与物理干扰的环境下，实现了76%的端到端闭环放置成功率（较无DR模型提升8%）。


OmniVLN：面向空地视觉语言导航的全方位3D感知和令牌高效LLM推理 Co-first Author, IEEE RA-L (SCI Q2 TOP, Under Review)


针对大规模3D场景中LLM空间推理缺失及上下文爆炸问题，基于Python, PyTorch与 ROS 2开发了一套全向感知驱动的具身智能Agent框架。前端融合旋转雷达与全景视觉，构建5层动态场景图，结合持续同调自适应房间分割与VLM混合剪枝，决策端首创立体8邻域与多分辨率空间注意力提示，实现 Zero-shot长程导航，SR达93.18%（视角依赖准确率提升 22.73%），Token成本降低69.98%。


A Review of Data Fusion and Deep Learning Models for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis. First Author, Published to In Proceedings of E-commerce and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI 2024)
